objective1.description: Eliminate the guards blocking the path

objective2.dial: The streets are a warzone. The Cypherites are trying to shut down EPN's broadcast node. You have to choose a side.

objective3.description: Fight your way to the Broadcast Node
objective3.dial: Stop them! The node must be secured!

objective4.dial: Will you activate the node for EPN or destroy it for the Cypherites?
